text:
sam.bates: Quick one — Acme support wants a guest Datadog account for a billing spike investigation. They only need logs for 2026-03-15 03:00-06:00 UTC and traces for invoice-payment-service. Can we do a timeboxed read-only role?

tara: We can but need to be careful about PII in logs. Who's the vendor? Do we have an NDA/contract? :thinking_face:

sam.bates: Vendor is PulseSupport (third-party). We have an LOA attached to the customer ticket (link: https://support.acme.com/cases/7890). No company-level contract with PulseSupport.

lee: If no contract, default safe path = temporary role + scoped views + explicit redaction. Eng-security needs to approve. Also prefer sharing an export (sanitized) over live console access when possible.

nina: +1 to export. If the customer specifically requests live access we can do a guest with minimal permissions and a strict session window (audit + screens).

eng-security-bot: FYI — per policy S-LOG-3, vendor console access must be: timeboxed <= 72h, least-privilege role, and logged via audit trail. Approval required from eng-security and legal.

tara: Steps I propose: 
1) Narrow query to invoice-payment-service + time window.
2) Run a scrub pipeline to mask email/address/cc numbers (fields: user_email, billing_address, cc_last4).
3) Produce sanitized export (preferred) and ask PulseSupport if that suffices.
4) If live access absolutely required: create temporary Datadog guest role with `logs_read` + `apm_services_read` scoped to invoice-payment-service, set expiry 72h, enable session recording, and restrict to specific IP range.

sam.bates: Sounds good. Two questions: how do we do the scrub pipeline quickly? and who signs off for the guest role?

lee: We have a reusable pipeline snippet in infra-playbooks: https://internal.redwood.dev/playbooks/log-redaction. Quick snippet:```
processor.type: mask
fields: ["user_email", "billing_address", "cc_full"]
mask_with: "[REDACTED]"
```
Run on a narrow timeframe and check a sample before export.

tara: Signoff = eng-security (me) + legal for vendor access. @nina can you check with legal for LOA coverage? If legal says OK, I can approve the role and scope it.

nina: On it, pinging legal. I’ll confirm whether the LOA is sufficient for a vendor guest account or whether we need a contract addendum. ETA ~2 business days.

sam.bates: If legal takes longer, can we export first and send sanitized files? That should unblock the customer faster.

tara: Yes — export first. Please attach the sample sanitized logfile to this thread once done so I can sanity-check. If sample looks good, I’ll sign off for export.

lee: Also FYI — if anyone tries to copy logs out of Datadog UI, that gets flagged in audit logs. Recommend generating a signed S3 export and share via presigned URL with expiry 24h.

sam.bates: Will do. I’ll run the pipeline for 03:00-06:00 UTC, grab a 100-line sample, sanitize, and upload to S3 with 24h presigned URL.

eng-security-bot: Checklist reminder: [ ] scrubbed sample uploaded, [ ] legal approval for vendor access, [ ] temporary role created (if required), [ ] audit events captured.

nina: Legal replied in DM — LOA is borderline. They want PulseSupport added to the customer LOA as an authorized subcontractor or we limit to sanitized exports only.

tara: Ok, export only then. Once legal confirms vendor-level wording we can revisit live access. For the export path, I'll approve after seeing the sample.

sam.bates: Uploading sample now: s3://redwood-support-exports/acme/1782003456/sample-sanitized.log (presigned link: https://s3.redwood.dev/presign/abc123 — expires in 24h).

lee: Quick spot-check: looks good. No emails or cc numbers. A couple of customer IDs remain in the message body — can we hash them instead of redacting so PulseSupport can map? Use SHA256 prefix: `cust_` + first8(hex).

sam.bates: Will re-run with hashing then re-upload.

tara: Thanks. After you re-upload, I’ll stamp export approved and we can close this ticket. Sam — please add a short note to the ticket documenting the steps and attach the presigned URL.

sam.bates: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:

eng-security-bot: Resolution logged: export-only path taken; legal requires subcontractor wording for live vendor access. Thread closed when Tara marks approved.
